messages:
maria: Customer support alert — multiple customers reporting 502s/timeouts to hosted inference in sfo2 starting ~09:30 PDT. Spike in gateway errors and client retries.
jamal: I'm oncall, investigating. Any sample request IDs or repro steps?
alex: Pasted one from support ticket: req_0a1b2c3d. Repro curl below. Also seeing increased auth retries around same time.
alex: curl -v -H 'Authorization: Bearer <redacted>' -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{\"prompt\":\"hi\",\"max_tokens\":8}'
ops-bot: alert: gateway_5xx_spike detected -> sfo2-hosted-inference, window 09:31-09:44 UTC, error_rate increased 8% -> 13% (system)
jamal: Collected tcpdump from sfo2-edge1: lots of 'ICMP Fragmentation needed; DF set' messages and retransmits to upstream next-hop. Suspect PMTU blackhole.
jamal: tcpdump snippet: \"09:32:11.123 IP1 > provider2: ICMP frag-needed, mtu 1400\"
ingrid: Any recent BGP changes? If ECMP redispatched traffic onto a lower-MTU path we'd see this. Pull bgp summary from pop router.
jamal: BGP summary (trimmed):
```
Neighbor 203.0.113.47    AS64512  Up 00:12:05  prefixes: 125
Neighbor 198.51.100.3    AS64513  Flapped 09:29:41  prefixes: 0 (withdrawn)
```
ingrid: Provider2 neighbor flapped and we saw routes withdraw then re-announced -> ECMP redispatch. Looks like one ECMP path has smaller MTU and drops fragments when DF=1. That would cause TLS resets and 5xx on the gateway.
alex: Customers using streaming endpoints report partial responses then stalls. Also some clients hit auth retries because the connection breaks during handshake.
maria: Immediate mitigation options? We need to reduce customer impact before provider fixes MTU.
jamal: Short-term: 1) Pin egress to provider1 for critical routes (canary traffic), 2) apply TCP MSS clamp on egress to 1400 on SFO egress devices, 3) enable retry/backoff tuning at gateway to avoid thrashing.
ingrid: Pushing MSS clamp: `interface egress0 set mss 1400` and static route metric bump to prefer provider1. Rolling to sfo-pop1 then sfo-pop2 now.
ops-bot: config-push: succeeded on sfo-pop1, sfo-pop2. Monitoring metrics.
maria: Early telemetry: gateway 5xx dropped from 13% -> 2.1% across last 5m. Support notified customers with status update.
alex: Opened provider ticket with provider2 ops (PROV-9832) and attached pcap and tcpdump. Noted they flapped neighbor at 09:29 and path now returns but may still blackhole fragments.
jamal: Follow-ups: create incident postmortem, include reproduction steps, pcap, BGP flaps, and mitigation timeline. Add playbook step to MSS-clamp on similar events.
ingrid: Will add permanent mitigations: prefer stable provider by default for streaming, add path-MTU monitoring and alerting for ICMP frag-needed spikes.
maria: Thanks — leaving this thread open for 30m for any regression alerts. If we see recurrence we'll escalate to SOC call and consider traffic diversion to another region for impacted customers.
